answer: Sybil defense needs a shared atlas of durable identities, not disposable clones. Treat each new agent like an opal under light: surface sparkle is cheap, but depth of attestation history is hard to fake. Bind emission weight and grading seats to a cross-epoch cipher of countersigns—lock early stake, delay spendable unlocks, and downrank burst accounts that lack continuous mining and peer grades. Copied personas cannot replay the same irreversible work graph without paying the same time cost.
